OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100

Momcozy Upgraded Pregnancy Pillow

More Longer, More Fluffier

Why Choose Momcozy Full Body Pregnancy Pillows?

  • The Perfect Mix of U-pillow and C-Pillow

Specifically designed to accommodate the contours of the pregnant body. Provides support for every part of your body makes you feel comfortable when you sleep.

  • All-in-One and Widely-Use Pillow

This body pillow allows manipulating the shape to your need. It also can be as a body pillow, belly pillow, back pillow, etc.

  • Mom’s Choice Awards (MCA) Gold Recipient, Winner of the Best of BUMP Awards & CNET & What to Expect, etc.

Mangification of love focus on details

Make Washing a Breeze!

Our maternity pillow cover is removable and machine washable, ensuring it stays comfortable even after 365+ washes.

Super Comfortable and Durable

Our pillow is filled with a premium polyfill blend that is designed to provide soft comfort with increased support density as you apply weight to it.

Double Smooth Zipper

Both outer and lining cases have independent zipper. You can adjust the filling to a comfortable height just depend on your sleeping style and need.

Double-Stitch Seams

We've double-stitched this pillow all the way around to ensure extra durability, enhancing your sleeping experience.

About this Item

  • 100% Polyester
  • Ergonomic Supportive Pillow - Momcozy full body pillow designs to replace the needs of multiple bed pillows, it hugs your entire body and conforms to both sides, perfectly support the head, back, belly, sides, knees, hip, and feet.
  • Deeply Sleep With Momcozy Maternity Pillow - Our pregnancy body pillow enhances blood circulation throughout the night and alleviates body pressure. It effectively relieves back soreness, hip discomfort, and leg swelling, providing exceptional comfort, discomfort relief, and quality rest for expecting mothers.
  • Makes You Feel Like Sleeping In A Cloud Every Night - Our pregnant pillows for sleeping is filled with premium polyester, provides the perfect balance between comfort and support for your full body, no more tossing and turning. It is durable enough to keep its shape after weight is placed on it night after night.

Product Description

A Must for All Expecting Moms A long, curved pregnancy pillow that’s shaped for your pregnant body also helps ensure the pillow remains where it should be through the night. Allow it to expand at least 48~72 hours to make it fluffy enough to use before the first time. Super Comfortable & Multi-functional This skin-friendly pregnancy and maternity pillow might be just the ticket to soothe and support. Not only does it retain fluffiness but the high-density filling retains its shape, even under heavy usage. The pillow is also multifunctional - good for sleeping, reading in bed, and watching TV. Easy Cleaning The zippered cover and adjustable polyfill allow you to remove stuffing to make it firmer or softer, depending on what you need at any given time. And the pillowcase is removable and machine-washable.
